page_title: PAR 1-1 VEN | Parma v Venezia 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Franco Carboni (Venezia) has tested the patience of referee Francesco Fourneau and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' A substitution has been made. Issa Doumbia goes off and Cheick Conde (Venezia) comes on.
88' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Joel Pohjanpalo as he is replaced by Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia).
87' Simon Sohm (Parma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francesco Fourneau had an easy-decision to make.
86' Fabio Pecchia prepares a substitution. Valentin Mihaila is replaced by Anas Haj Mohamed (Parma).

82' Drissa Camara (Parma) peels away from his marker to receive a lofted pass, but sends his rocket of a shot just wide of the right post from inside the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
81' After what seems an eternity, referee Francesco Fourneau decides there was an offside after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Venezia, play to continue.
80' The goal for Venezia is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.

78' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) displayed brilliant individual skill before blasting in a shot from inside the box. His terrific effort went straight into the bottom left corner, via a ricochet off the post. Zion Suzuki had no chance. The score sheet now reads 1:2.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bjarki Bjarkason trots off the pitch and is replaced by Alessio Zerbin (Venezia).
76' Parma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

75' Hernani (Parma) tries his luck from a long-range free kick and fires the ball to the top left corner, but Filip Stankovic is alert and thwarts the effort. The ball is out of play and Parma manage to earn a corner.
74' Bjarki Bjarkason (Venezia) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
73' 13:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
71' Hernani (Parma) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
70' Hernani (Parma) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
69' That will be all from Alessandro Vogliacco who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Antoine Hainaut (Parma).
66' Dennis Man (Parma) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Filip Stankovic gets down to his right to keep it out.
65' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
62' Venezia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
61' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Franco Carboni (Venezia) replacing Antonio Candela.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and John Yeboah departs the field of play to be replaced by Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia).
59' The corner is swung in but Venezia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

59' The ball is laid off to Issa Doumbia (Venezia) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom left corner and forces Zion Suzuki to make a decent save. The ball is out of play. Venezia will have a chance to score from a corner.
56' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Hernani (Parma) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Filip Stankovic no chance!
56' Hernani (Parma) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
55' Antonio Candela (Venezia) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul. The referee blows the whistle and gives a penalty to Parma!!
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Parma.

54' That was a nice football moment. Drissa Camara (Parma) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the bottom right corner. Filip Stankovic guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Parma.
52' Parma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
52' Parma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Corner kick. Parma will have an opportunity.

51' Filip Stankovic pulls off a great save to deny Valentin Mihaila (Parma), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner. Good work from Parma as they win a corner.

48' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Mandela Keita (Parma) comes off for Drissa Camara.
46' Half-time substitution. Pontus Almqvist (Parma) will not participate anymore and Dennis Man is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Fabio Pecchia decided to make a change. Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) is replaced by Ange-Yoan Bonny.
46' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+1' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Parma.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' That looked a certain handball by Gianluca Busio (Venezia) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!

43' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) skips past the defender inside the box and blasts the ball at goal, but sends the effort well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
42' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
39' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) commits a foul and Francesco Fourneau immediately signals a free kick.
38' Venezia seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
35' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.
33' Hernani (Parma) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
32' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antonio Candela (Venezia) was quite harsh and Francesco Fourneau didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
29' 56:44 – the ratio of ball possession.
26' Parma are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
24' Valentin Mihaila (Parma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Zion Suzuki into right side of the goal.
20' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) is going to take the penalty!
18' Francesco Fourneau shows a yellow card to Mandela Keita (Parma) for his blatant foul.
18' It’s a PENALTY to Venezia after the VAR review!

18' Play continues despite the shouts by some Venezia players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Francesco Fourneau interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
17' John Yeboah (Venezia) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
16' The resulting set piece from Parma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' The resulting free kick from Valentin Mihaila (Parma) ends up in the gloves of the keeper. The linesman makes the right call and Parma will have a corner.
13' John Yeboah (Venezia) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
13' John Yeboah (Venezia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
12' John Yeboah (Venezia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

9' Matteo Cancellieri (Parma) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
8' Parma take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

7' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The linesman points to the corner flag, Parma are going to take it.
5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Parma comes to nothing.
3' Bjarki Bjarkason (Venezia) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
2' Pontus Almqvist (Parma) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Venezia will take the kick-off.
Francesco Fourneau will officiate today.
